name: Nail clipper
summary: Pressing the long handle squeezes two sharp curved jaws together so they bite through a fingernail, and the jaws spring back open when you let go.

parts.name: Jaw strips
parts.role: Two springy steel strips joined at the back, with sharpened front edges that meet to cut.

parts.name: Centre pin
parts.role: A post through both strips that the handle hooks onto and pulls against.

parts.name: Press handle
parts.role: The long arm you push down to squeeze the jaws shut.
